তারিখ : ২৪ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪১৯ বঙ্গাব্দ/০৭ জুন, ২০১২ খ্রিস্টাব্দ।

Ministry of Finance: This entity is the government department responsible for issuing official regulatory notifications related to customs and value-added tax matters.
Internal Resources Division: This division of the government functions as the administrative body responsible for publishing and issuing statutory regulatory orders in the field of customs and taxation.

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the Government to grant exemptions or modify duties, in this instance by amending a prior notification concerning tariff codes.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act serves as a legal basis for the Government to issue notifications that adjust tax-related administrative or tariff provisions.
National Board of Revenue: The Government is mandated to consult with the National Board of Revenue before exercising its powers to amend existing customs and tax notifications.
S.R.O. 178-AIN/2010: This existing notification is amended by this order through the substitution of specific Harmonized System (H.S.) codes within its original tariff table.
Bangladesh Customs Tariff: The H.S. codes listed in the notification table are updated by replacing older codes with a new classification to align with current tariff requirements.
